newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Menem's heart in "perfect condition", says doctor.
newsitem.headline: Menem's heart in "perfect condition", says doctor.

text.p: President Carlos Menem's heart is in a "perfect condition", a physician said Friday after conducting a routine medical check of the 67-year-old Argentine leader.
"The president is very youthful," Dr Jorge Belardi said. "From a cardiovascular point of view, he is in perfect condition."
This was the sixth medical check-up since October 1993, when Menem was rushed to hospital and underwent surgery to remove a clot from a major neck artery.
